_doc: Built-in defaults. Do NOT edit this file - put overrides in your workspace config.json (default: ~/MusicStudio/config.json). Precedence, lowest to highest: generation -> hardware tier -> quality preset -> engine_overrides -> the request itself (CLI flag / dashboard field).

generation._doc: Applies to every track unless a style, workflow or request says otherwise.

hardware._doc: tier 'auto' detects VRAM with nvidia-smi (low <6GB, mid 6-12, high 12-20, ultra 20+). Set it to force one. Follows the ACE-Step 1.5 VRAM guidance: int8 quantization only on the smallest cards, 0.6B LM from 6GB, 1.7B from 12GB. Model names must exist in <ace_step_dir>/checkpoints (run `python scripts/engine.py check`). ACE-Step instrumentals are most stable at 30-180 s: make longer pieces by looping, not by asking for 8 minutes. offload_dit_to_cpu: with offload_to_cpu alone ACE-Step keeps the diffusion model on the GPU; on a 4-6 GB card nothing is left for the VAE, which then silently falls back to CPU decoding (minutes, looks frozen). 'low' sets it; other tiers set it automatically when total VRAM < 8 GB.

quality._doc: Presets trade speed for quality. 'thinking' lets the language model (LM) expand the caption and pick BPM/key - it is the biggest lever for 'sounds like what I described' and is switched off automatically when the tier has no LM. A preset may name a dit_model; if that checkpoint is not installed the tier model is used and the steps are clamped for it (turbo max 20) with a warning.

engine_overrides._doc: Pin any engine parameter here to force it across ALL presets (e.g. {"batch_size": 1}). Empty by default on purpose: a pinned value silently defeats the presets.

postprocess._doc: Targets used by the post-processing steps and the QC report.

loudness_presets._doc: Pick one when exporting (dashboard 響度, or postprocess.py run --loudness NAME) to override the workflow's own target.

workflow._doc: Which workflow a request uses when none is named. See workflows/*.json.

output._doc: Relative paths are inside the workspace.
